mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, od.order_detail_id, o.order_date, p.name, od.quantity, od.subtotal, o.order_status FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id WHERE memid=#{memid} ORDER BY o.order_date DESC
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(order_id), 0) + 1 as order_id FROM orders
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_id, memid, total_price, order_status, order_date) VALUES (( SELECT IFNULL(MAX(order_id), 0) + 1 AS order_id FROM orders as o), #{memid}, #{total_price}, #{order_status}, now());
